summary: Envoy Medical filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, reporting that on October 6, 2026 it entered a Dismissal Agreement with Atlas Merchant Capital SPAC Fund I LP resolving Delaware Chancery litigation over Atlas's alleged inability to redeem Class A shares in the company's September 2023 business combination with Anzu Special Acquisition Corp I. All claims will be dismissed with prejudice and no proceedings remain; no payment is owed by the company or other defendants. No special-situation transaction is implicated; watch disclosure of any related indemnity, insurance, or cost accrual.
